title: UpSafe$^\circ$C: Upcycling for Controllable Safety in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.02194v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of tasks, but remain vulnerable to safety risks such as harmful content generation and jailbreak attacks. Existing safety techniques---including external guardrails, inference-time guidance, and post-training alignment---each face limitations in balancing safety, utility, and controllability. In this work, we propose UpSafe$^\circ$C, a unified framework for enhancing LLM safety through safety-aware upcycling. Our approach first identifies safety-critical layers and upcycles them into a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) structure, where the router acts as a soft guardrail that selectively activates original MLPs and added safety experts. We further introduce a two-stage SFT strategy to strengthen safety discrimination while preserving general capabilities. translated_title: UpSafe°C：面向大语言模型可控安全性的升级改造方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的任务中取得了显著进展，但仍然容易受到安全风险的威胁，例如有害内容生成和越狱攻击。现有的安全技术——包括外部防护栏、推理时引导和后训练对齐——在平衡安全性、实用性和可控性方面各有局限。在这项工作中，我们提出了UpSafe°C，一个通过安全感知升级改造来增强大语言模型安全性的统一框架。我们的方法首先识别安全关键层，并将其升级改造为稀疏的混合专家结构，其中路由器充当软防护栏，选择性地激活原始MLP和新增的安全专家。我们进一步引入两阶段SFT策略，在保持通用能力的同时增强安全判别能力。为了在推理时实现灵活控制，我们引入了安全温度机制，允许……
tldr: 提出UpSafe°C框架，通过将安全关键层升级为稀疏MoE结构、利用路由器作为软防护栏、结合两阶段SFT和可调节的安全温度机制，在保持通用能力的同时实现大语言模型推理时可灵活控制的安全防护。
en_tdlr: UpSafe°C upcycles safety-critical layers into a sparse MoE structure where the router serves as a soft guardrail, combined with two-stage SFT and an inference-time safety temperature mechanism, enabling flexible and controllable safety for LLMs while preserving general capabilities.
